manifestMaxAgeMs?
optional manifestMaxAgeMs?: number;

Longest time, in ms, a fetched manifest is used before ensureFresh() revalidates it. The effective bound is the smaller of this and the manifest response's Cache-Control max-age (no-cache and no-store mean 0). Default 300000. See "Manifest freshness".

Inherited from
ClientOptions.manifestMaxAgeMs

maxResponseBytes?
optional maxResponseBytes?: number;

Largest response body the client reads, in bytes. A larger Content-Length is refused before reading; a body without one is read up to the limit, then cancelled. Default 4194304 (4 MiB).

Inherited from
ClientOptions.maxResponseBytes

maxRetryAfterMs?
optional maxRetryAfterMs?: number;

Longest Retry-After the client will honor automatically, in ms. Default 30000.

Inherited from
ClientOptions.maxRetryAfterMs

retries?
optional retries?: number;

Retries after rate_limited/unavailable. Default 1.

Inherited from
ClientOptions.retries

sessionId?
optional sessionId?: string;
Inherited from
ClientOptions.sessionId

timeoutMs?
optional timeoutMs?: number;

Abort one request after this many milliseconds, redirects and reading the body included. Default 30000. Each retry and each poll is a new request with its own timeout.

ClientOptions.timeoutMs

Type Aliases

CheckStatus

type CheckStatus = "pass" | "fail" | "warn" | "skip";

Coverage

type Coverage = 
  | {
  check: string;
}
  | {
  test: string;
};

Where every numbered requirement in spec/AXE-PROTOCOL.md is verified: by a conformance check id (runs against any URL) or by a named test in a package. A test asserts that every [P-...] identifier in the spec appears here.
